contract: POST /api/podcasts is admin-only and creates one podcast library item: it requires media.metadata, validates an optional autoDownloadSchedule with node-cron, resolves the library and one of its folders (404), requires a non-empty path inside the selected folder (400), rejects an existing item at that path (400), creates the folder, writes the podcast and library item in one transaction, downloads an http(s) cover image into the item folder when the URL is set, emits item_added to every user who can access the item and answers the expanded library item. Rejections answer 401/403/400/404 before any write; a failed database transaction answers 500.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the five create scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: force is not applicable: the create route has no force/override parameter; an existing path is rejected with 400 instead of being replaced.
The 500 branch for a failed database transaction is unexecuted: it needs the SQLite write to fail, which no request input reaches.

The stored cover library file is reported by the API with fileType "unknown" because LibraryFile derives the type from metadata.format, which the create path does not store; the scenario asserts the filename, extension, path and size instead.

invariants.contract: POST /api/podcasts answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin, 400 without media or media.metadata, for an invalid autoDownloadSchedule cron expression, for an empty or non-string path, for a path outside the selected library folder and for a path that already belongs to an item or is an existing file, and 404 for an unknown libraryId or a folderId of another library; no rejected request creates a row, a folder or an event.

An accepted request answers the expanded library item of mediaType podcast with the posted metadata (numeric itunes ids converted to strings, description sanitized), the tags, genres, autoDownloadEpisodes, autoDownloadSchedule, lastEpisodeCheck at creation time, maxEpisodesToKeep 0, maxNewEpisodesToDownload 3 and no episodes, and stores the library item row (path, relPath, mediaType, title, folder id, isFile/isMissing/isInvalid false, size 0) plus the podcast row with the same values and the downloaded cover.jpg in its libraryFiles.

Omitted values take the server defaults: autoDownloadEpisodes false, autoDownloadSchedule the server podcast episode schedule, explicit false, genres and tags empty lists, the other metadata null; a cover URL that cannot be fetched is stored as imageUrl without a cover file and the create still succeeds.

Repeating a create for a path that already belongs to an item answers 400 "Podcast already exists", adds no row, emits no item_added and leaves the stored podcast row unchanged, while a second create at a different path in the same folder stores an independent item.
